Body.Content:
You can now transfer a subscription to a colleague, a different account you own, or someone in a different organization. This feature is globally available for intranational transfers of the following subscription types:
  • Pay-As-You-Go
  • MSDN Dev and Test Pay-As-You-Go
  • Visual Studio Professional subscribers
  • Visual Studio Test Professional subscribers
  • MSDN Platforms subscribers
  • Visual Studio Enterprise with MSDN (benefit)
  • Visual Studio Enterprise (BizSpark) subscribers
  • Action Pack
